_comment: Exact returned AGMARKNET commodity labels -> distinct catalogue product forms. Ginger mappings were observed in the earlier current/variety probes; new grain, seed, fresh vegetable and split-dal mappings were observed in official current-daily responses recorded in evals/results/live-smoke/mandi-mappings-2026-10-30.json. Commodity query filters are fuzzy; readers must match the returned label exactly. Missing/unverified mappings stay unavailable. Price units retain explicit convention-assumption flags. Focused crop mappings additionally verified against exact labels in the complete priced current-daily inventory dated 2026-10-30. Cane, shallot, curry leaves and coriander seed remain unmapped where no exact priced form was observed; sugar is not sugarcane and lime/galgal are not Citrus limon.
